definition: For EVERY denotation F:W→W→Prop, diagonal validity implies necessitated validity. This scope can exceed any particular object language; it is not a proof-calculus soundness or completeness predicate.
note: Analyst formulation for issue #1049. Neither naming/context policy nor metaphysical applicability is defended. SEP Modal Logic §§10/16 is navigation only; attribution deferred. No new modal calculus or reality claim.
